description: Mounted nose-high on a pole at a gate in Khartoum. A Wikimedia Commons photograph taken on 9 April 2019 during the sit-in outside the air force command shows a pole-mounted MiG-21 with a three-digit nose number consistent with 344 although the resolution does not permit a certain reading. The identity 344 comes from Wrecks and Relics Online whose record for this point was last updated in April 2013 so survival through the 2023 to 2025 fighting is unverified.
